DJOURNED DEBATES 
 
Bill No. 609 – The Residents-in-Care Bill of Rights Act 
 
The Assembly resumed the adjourned debate on the proposed motion of Ms. Chartier: That Bill No. 609 – 
The Residents-in-Care Bill of Rights Act – be now read a second time. 
 
Pursuant to Rule 54(3), the debate continuing, and pursuant to Rule 27(4), the question being put, it was 
negatived on the following Recorded Division:
